os_list.name: Omarchy Quattro v1.0.7 - Arch Linux ARM (Pi 5 NVMe)
os_list.description: 100% like-for-like Omarchy v4.0.3 parity on Raspberry Pi 5. Features Hyprland 0.56.2 on Wayland with Aquamarine & Quickshell, Walker + Elephant launcher, Tokyo Night theme, 16k kernel, PCIe Gen 3 NVMe tuning, Argon active cooling, Flatpak layer (Obsidian, Pinta), Spotify webapp, and complete AI suite (openclaw, hermes, cursor-cli, muse, omp, claude, codex, copilot, chatgpt, perplexity, vscode).

subitems.name: Omarchy Quattro v1.0.7 (Zstandard — Hyprland + Full 4.0.3 AI Suite)
subitems.description: Boots straight to Hyprland 0.56.2 desktop with Walker launcher, Tokyo Night theme, btop, Chromium, and complete Omarchy v4.0.3 AI suite (OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor CLI).
